newsitem.title: USA: Norand stake held by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Norand stake held by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it holds a 5.04 percent stake in Norand Corp or 395,200 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 115,200 common shares bought between January 22 and February 10 at prices ranging from $32.9860 to $33.3531 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Norand, based in Cedar Rapids, Ia., is a manufacturer and marketer of mobile computing systems and in-premise wireless local area networks using radio frequency technology.
